title: Two clocks on one unit

members.role: two durations on ONE unit (years): the long bar deemphasized, the short bar crimson - the page's own colours - built on its axes while the long one is spoken
the short bar's figure - the claim ('5 years') - written by the hand on its top on its word ('about five years'); the long bar keeps its printed value

does: Two durations on one unit: the long bar deemphasized while it is spoken, the short one crimson; on the short one's word the hand writes its figure on its top - the claim the page was drawn to make.

use_when.shape: two numbers, one unit: a long and a short duration
use_when.use: a contrast of two clocks where the SHORT one is the claim ('twenty years ... about five years'): the long one deemphasized as it is spoken, the short one's figure on its word
use_when.dont: two units (E53), when the long one is the claim (emphasize it instead), or more than two durations (rank them)

source: P69 T35 (the operator 2026-09-22); proved as a beat by projects/_proofs/p69-recipes/proof_p69_recipes.py on Steel and Paper H row 19 ('Railway steel sat waiting ... about five years', take 430.41 s) on ev-two-clocks-bars-v1 - no approved cut carries it
